_readme: ALL WORDS ON THE INVITATION LIVE IN THIS FILE.
Edit any value on the right-hand side of the colon, save, then run `npm run build`.
Nothing else needs to change - no code, no components.
en = English text (shown when the guest taps the language button)
1. Only change the text INSIDE the double quotes.
2. Keep every key that exists in `fa` also in `en`, and vice versa.
3. `invitation` is a LIST of paragraphs. Add or remove lines freely -
each line becomes its own paragraph on the page.
4. If you need a double quote inside text, write it as \" .
The couple's names, venue, date and guest list are NOT here -

invitation: با عشق و سپاس از اینکه در این روز خاص در کنار ما هستید، دعوت می‌کنیم تا شادی این لحظه‌ها را با ما سهیم شوید.
ده سال پیش، دو قلب پیمان بستند که دست در دست هم، راه را تا انتها بروند.
حضور گرم شما، زیباترین هدیه‌ی این شب خواهد بود.

pillars.body: برای جشن گرفتن عشق و همراهی

pillars.body: هر روز با هم زیباتر از دیروز

invitation: With love and gratitude for being part of this special day, we invite you to share the joy of these moments with us.
Ten years ago, two hearts promised to walk the road together, hand in hand.
Your presence will be the most beautiful gift of the evening.

pillars.title: Your Presence
pillars.body: is the greatest gift of all

pillars.title: With Love
pillars.body: every day lovelier than the last
